title: 第11章 你太弱了第12章 抽空元气
content_zh:
当叶祈安兑换到凝元丹回到小木屋的时候，出现了让他异常愤怒的一幕。
叶祈安看着木床上的重伤昏迷过去的王大海，双拳紧握，一股凌厉的剑意在周身环绕。
语气森然说到：“是谁做的。”
难不成是白裙女子做的？不可能！她虽说不讲道理了些，但绝对不会伤害一个无辜弱小的人。
白裙女子见到叶祈安归来，清冷的说道：“肋骨断裂三根，经脉受损，静养一个月是避免不了了。”
叶祈安先是上前查看了王大海的安危，体内有着一股庞大的生机在修复着他受损的经脉内伤。
心里暗道。
看来是她及时救了大海一命，否则这辈子的武道都毁了，更别说进入外门弟子。
随后叶祈安看向白裙女子此刻正端坐在木椅上悠闲的品茗喝茶。
一双逆天大长腿并拢，赤着玉足，元气包裹着一尘不染。
“多谢，我又欠了你一个人情。”
“这是还给你的凝元丹。”
“有需要我的地方，尽管开口，一定帮忙。”
白裙女子听后转头看向叶祈安，摇摇头，声音依旧是那么清冷，不含一丝感情。
“你...太弱了。”
就一句话，直接是将叶祈安怼的无言以对。
弱？
确实，跟眼前这个恐怖女相比，确实是弱的不行。
但如今他突破地元境，即便是半步天元境，他都有自信一战。
随后叶祈安也倒了一杯茶，眼神如同剑芒一般看向远方。

而那个方向正是外门弟子的住处。
王大海为人老实，必定不会主动招惹别人。
而杂役弟子中实力最高的也就是六重淬体境啊。
跟大海一个境界，不可能伤的如此重。
那就只有一个可能，针对自己而来。
他自进入苍澜学院起，处处跟自己作对也就只有朱家的人。
朱刚这个杂役弟子和他的族兄已经被解决。
最后就只有外门弟子朱烈了！
思绪间，白裙女子突然开口说道：“有人来了。”
“一个地元境初期，两个淬体境九重。”
白裙女子依旧是自顾自的喝茶，美眸扫向叶祈安，心中暗道，他的麻烦还挺多。
看来这个人的遇害也是因为他。
叶祈安走出房门，只见朱烈带着两个小弟缓缓走来。
他嫌弃的看着周围的破木屋，不屑的说道。
“这杂役弟子的地方还真不是人待下去的，果然只有你们这样的废物才能待下去！”
旁边的小弟也是附和着大笑。
“哈哈，没错，朱少，像您这样的天命之人，迟早是要进入内门当中享受最好修炼洞天的。”
几人嘲讽一遍之后才睁眼看向叶祈安。
“没想到你竟活着回来了。”
“也就是说朱刚那个废物没能把你拿下？”

“真是白白浪费老子给的元石培养！”
content_en:
When Ye Qian exchanged the Ning Yuan Dan and returned to the cabin, a scene appeared that made him extremely angry.
Ye Qian'an looked at Wang Dahai, who was seriously injured and unconscious on the wooden bed, clenching his fists, and a sharp sword intent surrounded him.
He said in a solemn tone: "Who did it?"
Could it be that the woman in the white dress did it? impossible! Although she is a little unreasonable, she will never hurt an innocent and weak person.
When the woman in the white dress saw Ye Qian's return, she said coldly: "Three ribs were broken and the meridians were damaged. Resting for a month is inevitable."
Ye Qian first stepped forward to check Wang Dahai's safety. There was a huge vitality in his body that was repairing his damaged meridians.
I thought to myself.
It seems that she saved Dahai's life in time, otherwise the martial arts in this life will be ruined, let alone becoming an outer disciple.
Then Ye Qian looked at the woman in the white dress who was sitting on a wooden chair leisurely drinking tea.
A pair of heaven-defyingly long legs are placed together, with bare jade feet, wrapped in vitality and spotless.
"Thank you, I owe you another favor."
"This is the Yuan Ning Dan returned to you."
"If you need me anywhere, just ask and I will help."
After hearing this, the woman in the white dress turned to look at Ye Qian and shook her head. Her voice was still so cold and without any emotion.
"You... are too weak."
Just one sentence left Ye Qian speechless.
weak?
Indeed, compared to the scary woman in front of him, she is indeed weak.
But now that he has broken through to the Earth Yuan realm, he is confident to fight even if he is half a step into the Tian Yuan realm.
Then Ye Qian also poured a cup of tea, looking into the distance like a sword.
And that direction is where the outer disciples live.
Wang Dahai is an honest man and will definitely not take the initiative to provoke others.
And among the handyman disciples, the one with the highest strength is in the sixth level of body tempering.
Being in the same realm as the sea, it is impossible to be injured so badly.
Then there is only one possibility, it is for yourself.
Ever since he entered Canglan Academy, the only people from the Zhu family who have been against him at every turn.
Zhu Gang, the handyman disciple, and his clan brother have been dealt with.
In the end, only the outer disciple Zhu Lie was left!
While thinking, the woman in the white dress suddenly said: "Someone is coming."
"One is at the early stage of the Earth Yuan Realm, and two are at the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm."
The woman in the white dress was still drinking tea by herself, her beautiful eyes glanced at Ye Qian, and she thought to herself that he was in quite a lot of troubles.
It seems that this man was killed because of him.
Ye Qian walked out of the room and saw Zhu Lie walking slowly with his two younger brothers.
He looked at the broken wooden houses around him with disgust and said disdainfully.
"This place for servant disciples is really not for people to stay in. As expected, only trash like you can stay here!"
The boy next to him also laughed in agreement.
"Haha, that's right, Mr. Zhu, a destined person like you will sooner or later enter the inner sect to enjoy the best cultivation cave."
After several people mocked him, they opened their eyes and looked at Ye Qian.
"I didn't expect you to come back alive."
"Does that mean Zhu Gang, that loser, couldn't take you down?"
"What a waste of the Yuan Stone cultivation I gave you!"
